title: Add migration 003: users.marketing_opt_in
prompt: Marketing consent is landing next sprint. Add migration 003 to the quote API: a marketing_opt_in flag on users, stored as an integer, defaulting to 0 for new rows, and every existing row must end up with 0 as well. Follow the conventions the existing migrations use and do not edit or renumber 001 or 002: app.db.apply_migrations must bring both a fresh database and an already-migrated database to the same schema. Keep the visible tests green.

criteria.desc: Migrations 001 to 003 give a fresh database the column with default 0
An already-migrated, populated database gains the column with backfill 0 and no data loss
The fixture's visible test suite stays green

notes: Critical slot. Schema changes route R2 under the v2 policy. Both database paths are exercised because ALTER TABLE defaults and backfill diverge easily on sqlite.
